locations.note: Home of Sarif Industries, where security chief Adam Jensen is rebuilt with augmentations after an attack on the company.
Pritchard traces the hacking signal to an abandoned factory in Highland Park, where the Tyrants guard a FEMA detention camp.
Adam Jensen's China is Lower Hengsha, the invented two-tier city on Hengsha Island off Shanghai, with Upper Hengsha built over it.
Jensen infiltrates the Picus media conglomerate's Montreal headquarters and finds Eliza Cassan.
Jensen stows away in a stasis pod and wakes in a secret base in Singapore, where the kidnapped scientists are held.
The finale at Hugh Darrow's Panchaea, an invented climate-engineering platform in the Arctic Ocean.

routes.name: Adam Jensen
routes.note: Adam Jensen chases the attackers of Sarif Industries from Detroit to Hengsha and Montreal, back through Detroit and Hengsha to Singapore, and ends on Panchaea in the Arctic.
